title: DECISION: did_sig_valid in SQLite only, no IPLD schema bump
description: DID signature verification status is stored as a nullable INTEGER column in the SQLite overview table (via ALTER TABLE migration), not in the IPLD ArticleRootNode. The IPLD schema version remains at 1. This is correct for two reasons: (1) did_sig_valid is a local server-computed judgment, not author-produced content, so it does not belong in the content-addressed IPLD block whose CID must be stable; (2) root_node.rs explicitly states that additive optional fields do not require a schema version bump, and adding a mutable verification flag to an immutable CID-addressed structure would be architecturally wrong regardless.
